description: This PHP class file defines the 'codeTrackerCommands' class, which manages code tracker operations including creation, editing, deletion, and connection checking within the TestLink project. It handles user interface initialization, permission checks, and interaction with the 'tlCodeTracker' manager for data persistence.

classes.name: codeTrackerCommands
classes.description: Manager class handling user interface and interactions related to code tracking within TestLink.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the class with database handler and sets up code tracker manager.

methods.description: Returns the whitelist of GUI operations.

methods.name: initGuiBean
methods.description: Initializes GUI components for code tracker management, setting labels and button states.

methods.description: Prepares a new code tracker entity for creation.

methods.description: Handles creation process, including validation and persisting new code tracker.

methods.description: Processes updates to an existing code tracker.

methods.description: Checks connectivity for a specific code tracker configuration.
